name: goap_action_relevance_filter
purpose: Per user request: 'we do also need a way of reducing the entire action pool to the relevant action set (via input/output contracts)'. Confirmed first (rust-runtime/src/ir/hosts.rs's plan_facts) that the real planner already searches EVERY registered action at EVERY search node with no pre-filtering -- as the registry of proven-correct actions grows, this matters increasingly.
mechanism: Classical-planning relevance pruning (relaxed reachability): given a full CATALOG of candidate actions and a goal, works BACKWARD from the goal's own facts, keeping only actions whose effects could contribute (via real argument-aware fact matching, same uppercase-first-letter-is-a-variable convention the logic engine uses), recursively adding their own preconditions as newly-needed facts, until a fixpoint.
scaled_test: 23 REAL actions drawn from every actual action_add call found across the whole codebase (self_hosting/examples/goal_oriented_build_demo.patlang, goap_parameterized_demo.patlang, goal_pursue_activate_demo.patlang, paradigm_gallery demos, friendly_cli/lib/ai_engine.patlang, imggen_engine.patlang, smart_engine.patlang, tool_discovery.patlang, plus this session's own experiments) -- not synthetic test actions.

results.note: plan() correctly chose the CHEAPER 3-step route (compile_b+compile_a+link, cost 10) over the pricier single-action alternative (direct_ship, cost 100) -- real confirmation of GOAP's documented cost-optimal search behaviour, not previously demonstrated at this scale

correctly kept two independently-registered, non-colliding-named actions (act_md_to_docx and discovered_pandoc_md_docx) that happen to have the identical precond/effect shape -- genuinely redundant alternate routes, both validly kept
coincidentally correct with the OLD name-only dedup, since only one of two same-named build_house actions ever actually matched during this specific goal

DELIBERATE TARGETED TEST that exposed the real bug: only ONE of the two genuinely different, same-named build_house actions survived under the old name-only dedup, silently leaving one goal fact unreachable

real_bug_found_and_fixed_at_this_larger_: the earlier (small-catalog-tested) version deduped candidate actions by NAME ALONE (kept_names) -- confirmed correct by accident on the smaller 8-action catalog and even on 3 of these 4 real goals, but a deliberately targeted goal (requiring BOTH same-named build_house actions' effects simultaneously) proved it silently drops a genuinely relevant, differently-bodied action whenever two same-named actions are BOTH relevant to one goal. Fixed by deduping on the FULL ACTION IDENTITY (name+preconds+effects as a composite key, goap_action_identity/goap_contains_identity) instead of name alone -- re-verified: the targeted test now correctly keeps BOTH build_house entries.
acknowledged_limitation: user's own framing, verbatim: 'big job, to be fair, and search space grows as we develop more proven correct actions' -- tested at 23 real actions from 8 source files; the fixpoint loop is still a simple nested re-scan (O(actions^2) worst case per goal), fine at this scale, would need a real index structure at hundreds+.
